claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_planar_portal
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit variants. Gate's core operation is opening a traversable portal to another plane — creatures that pass through are instantly transported. This maps to the v4 transport_exile effect atom, but no OngoingOperation variant can express it without lying.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. Anything that does so is instantly transported to the other plane, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the portal.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: circular_portal_shape
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Area attachment only supports sphere shape. Gate creates an oriented circular disk (5–20 ft diameter) with a distinct traversable front and non-traversable back. A sphere cannot honestly represent a directional planar opening.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose. The portal has a front and a back on each plane where it appears. Travel through the portal is possible only by moving through its front.

discrepancies: no content/gate.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
